rule: Everything in GrounUp must belong to exactly one of five categories. Nothing exists outside them.
enforcement: tests/governance/registry.test.ts — the build fails if any artifact is unclassified, doubly classified, or violates its category's invariants.

invariants.rule: An engine is deterministic: the same input always produces the same output.
invariants.why: A number that changes between runs cannot be audited, defended in a claim, or reconciled against a prior version.
invariants.enforced_by: Determinism tests in each engine suite; the PDF engine renders identical bytes for identical input.

invariants.rule: An engine performs no I/O. No database, no network, no clock, no filesystem. Anything it needs is passed in.
invariants.why: An engine that reads the world cannot be tested exhaustively, and cannot be reasoned about when it produces a surprising number.
invariants.enforced_by: packages/engine has zero runtime dependencies; connector and ingestion engines take injected HttpFetch/OcrProvider; every clock is injected.

invariants.rule: An engine shows its work. Every authoritative figure carries a derivation.
invariants.why: Master AI specification section 23: never hide calculations. A number a customer cannot check is a number they cannot defend to an owner.
invariants.enforced_by: Every engine result type carries a `derivation` or `basis` string, asserted by test.

invariants.rule: An engine is authoritative over AI for any figure it can compute.
invariants.why: RULE-008. Language models produce confident wrong arithmetic; deterministic code does not.
invariants.enforced_by: The AI system prompt forbids computing cost, price, production or duration; validateFindings rejects findings that do.

invariants.rule: A library carries the three-tier scope: platform seed (company_id null, enterprise_group_id null), enterprise group, and company override.
invariants.why: A company must be able to override a seeded rate without editing anyone else's, and without the platform losing the original.
invariants.enforced_by: Registry test asserts every LIBRARY table has a nullable company_id and an enterprise_group_id.

invariants.rule: A library row carries its source and its confidence.
invariants.why: RULE-010. A production rate from a company's own actuals and one from a seeded national average must not look alike to an estimator.
invariants.enforced_by: production_rates constraints; the confidence engine; source_confidence tests.

invariants.rule: Overriding a platform row never mutates it.
invariants.why: The platform seed is shared. A company that could edit it would silently change every other company's estimate.
invariants.enforced_by: RLS policies; the metric_definitions override test in tests/db/semantic.test.ts.

invariants.rule: An entity is owned by exactly one company, and row level security is ENABLEd and FORCEd on it.
invariants.why: One company must never read another's records. This is the platform's single most important property.
invariants.enforced_by: app.assert_security_gates() at the end of every migration adding tables; 51 RLS tests.

invariants.rule: A child row cannot be attached to a parent owned by a different company.
invariants.why: RLS alone does not prevent it for a user who legitimately belongs to two companies.

invariants.rule: Anything consequential is append-only or version-immutable, never edited in place.
invariants.why: An issued estimate, a certified pay application and an audit entry are records of what was said at a moment. Editing one destroys the record.

invariants.rule: A workflow has an explicit state column with a constrained set of states.
invariants.why: A process whose states are implied by other columns cannot be reported on, audited, or resumed.
invariants.enforced_by: Registry test asserts every WORKFLOW table has a state/status column with a CHECK constraint or enum type.

invariants.rule: A terminal state requires the evidence that justifies it.
invariants.why: A closed incident with no root cause, or a settled claim with no resolution, is a checkbox rather than a record.
invariants.enforced_by: Table CHECK constraints: safety_incidents root cause, deficiencies verification note, work_orders resolution, connector_runs error message.

invariants.why: Segregation of duties. An approval tier that the requester can satisfy is not a control.

categories.name: AI Agent
categories.definition: Assists users and automates work within governance.

invariants.rule: An agent's maximum authority is 'draft'. It proposes; it never commits.
invariants.why: RULE-008. AI must not alter approved estimates, libraries, contracts, schedules, billing, permissions or safety-critical data without the required approval workflow.
invariants.enforced_by: ai_agents authority cap; toFindingRow always writes state 'proposed'; the ai_findings acceptance trigger.

invariants.rule: A factual claim must carry a citation to the source it came from.
invariants.why: An uncited claim about a drawing cannot be checked, and an estimator has no way to know whether to trust it.
invariants.enforced_by: validateFindings rejects factual findings without citations.

invariants.rule: An agent never performs arithmetic an engine can perform.
invariants.why: The deterministic engine is authoritative. See ENGINE-04.

invariants.rule: Acceptance of a finding records who accepted it and when.
invariants.why: Once a human accepts an AI proposal, responsibility transfers. That transfer must be on the record.
invariants.enforced_by: ai_findings acceptance trigger; the Plans screen records the reviewer.
